errors.evidence: The upper red dotted line begins at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 0.8. It only rises above 1.2 later, around x=2.

The description fails to mention the initial trend of the upper red line, which rises from approximately 0.8 at x=1 to a peak above 1.2 around x=2-3, before it begins to decrease. The description incorrectly implies the line decreases from the start.
The lower red dotted line starts at a value of approximately -0.6 or -0.7 at x=1, which is significantly lower than the stated -0.2.
